messages:
Morgan: heads up - deploy-bot aborted the promote into prod. smoke e2e hung on migration test 'users_migration_end_to_end' and timed out. tagging @DevOps, this is in the 21:00 UTC change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote 9021 ABORTED: smoke-failure (e2e.timeout). failing test: users_migration_end_to_end. Logs pinned to job artifacts.

QA-Leo: Reproduced locally on staging: the migrator tries to get advisory lock and waits ~5m then times out. stack: migrator.wait_for_lock -> DB advisory_lock -> timeout.

DevOps: Any DB-side errors? connection spikes, long-running tx?

SRE-Jen: From pg logs on staging-migrator-0: 'WARNING: canceling statement due to statement timeout' followed by 'could not obtain lock on relation users_idx' - looks like previous migration job didn't release a lock.

Morgan: We have three options: 1) delay the change window and investigate (time expensive), 2) pin promote to last image tag that passed smoke (v2026-03-22-build-912), or 3) force skip the migration in the promotion and add post-deploy job. Thoughts?

Janet: PM and support prefer minimal user impact. Pin to last-known-good image is safest for cut. We can follow up with hotfix deploy after root-cause.

QA-Leo: Confirmed v2026-03-22-build-912 passes smoke. migration is only in v2026-03-23-build-934 which includes a changed lock sequence.

DevOps: Pinning steps: update promote manifest to set image-tag=v2026-03-22-build-912, re-run deploy-bot. That avoids touching DB. Note: we should include a release-note entry that we deferred the migration.

SRE-Jen: I'll open an incident: INC-2026-071, severity P2: "migrator advisory lock hang on staging runners". Assigning to infra-migrations. We'll collect traces and previous migrator invocation timestamps.

Morgan: Doing the pin now. Will create a short release note: "Promote paused due to migrator lock timeout; promoting previous image v2026-03-22-build-912 to meet change window. Migration fix will follow."

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual image-pin requested by Morgan. Promote queued for image v2026-03-22-build-912. Smoke expected in ~4m.

DevOps: Also snapshot the DB and migrator logs from staging-migrator-{0,1} before any retries. QA, can you attach the local reproduction steps to the incident?

QA-Leo: Yep added repro steps + minimal script in incident.

SRE-Jen: Snapshot taken, incident created, correlation id 0a1b2c.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Smoke for v2026-03-22-build-912 PASSED. Promote completed.

Morgan: Cut completed. Release notes updated: "Promotion reverted to last passing image due to a migration lock timeout observed in preflight smoke tests; migration deferred pending investigation (INC-2026-071)."

Janet: Nice quick decision. We'll schedule a migration rollback plan and follow-up postmortem. :thumbsup:
